policy: two fixed regularization configurations; four fresh 20-epoch runs; no independent evaluation pool

checkpoint_selection.soft_ce: minimum validation soft cross-entropy, then calibration discrepancy, then earliest epoch
checkpoint_selection.accuracy: maximum validation hard accuracy, then earliest epoch

cost_estimate_before_run.basis: measured seed 20261119 20-epoch endpoint runs at 1e-5, 1e-4, 3e-4 and 1e-3; dropout may add modest compute overhead
cost_estimate_before_run.note: Estimate only; no reference run is repeated.
